description: Append-only metrics writer. Every agent calls this at the end of its invocation (and at heartbeat) to emit one structured event capturing tokens, context-budget consumption, tool-call counts, latency, approval gates hit, and outcome. Output feeds the observer agent and /ai-metrics. Generic — never embeds vendor-specific fields.
checklist: 1. Validate envelope has trace_id; refuse if absent (every metric must be correlatable)
3. Build the event per the inputs schema below; never include secrets, user content, or full file bodies
4. Token counts: pass-through from the host runtime if available; null is acceptable but discouraged
5. Append exactly one JSON line (jsonl, one event per line); never rewrite prior lines
6. Mirror a one-line human-readable entry into the daily session log via log-action with action='metric-recorded', files_affected=[metrics file]
7. On disk-full or write failure, surface the error to the caller; never swallow

verdict_handoff.description: Next agent if this was a routing/handoff event
